custom_expected:
EXPECTED (per spec): changing a user's role triggers a forced logout; the new role takes effect on next login.
OBSERVED: session invalidation is observable as the prior session receiving HTTP 403 after an identity switch, forcing re-auth. (The server-side session-destruction mechanism is implementation detail, not a spec assertion; do not assert Redis internals.)
VIU: the isolated 'admin changes user's role -> that user's live session forced to re-auth' scenario could not be fully isolated in-browser due to SSO; verify with two independent sessions.
custom_preconds: An active user session; an admin changes that user's role
custom_steps:
1. With a user logged in, change their role (as admin)
2. Observe the affected session
title: Changing a user's role forces re-authentication
